title: Mastering Security Logging: Essential Tips for SaaS & B2B Companies
description:
Uncover the importance of logging for situational awareness in your business. This short guide explains why and how to implement effective logging strategies in AWS, SaaS applications, and more. Learn about tools like CloudTrail, Sumo, Splunk, and Datadog, and understand the best practices for data retention. Perfect for B2B and SaaS companies seeking to enhance their cybersecurity.
